### Warranty Coverage
Our commercial-style espresso machines typically come with extended warranty periods, usually ranging from 2 to 5 years, depending on the model. The warranty covers manufacturing defects and malfunctions. We also offer a dedicated service center for repairs and maintenance.

### Shipping and Delivery
We ship our espresso machines via freight, which ensures safe and secure transportation. You can expect to receive your machine within 3-7 business days, depending on your location. We offer in-home delivery and installation services for an additional fee, which can help ensure a smooth delivery process.
